args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west), with error rate at 0.18 and health status unhealthy. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully (status: rolled_out). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.0 was the latest healthy one). The rollback completed successfully in all regions.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure, the rollback action, and the need for root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0, healthy in all regions, with error rate back down to 0.002.
